title: Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer, Vinted Pay
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>As Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer in Vinted Pay, you will be the staff-level security engineer inside our regulated payments business - and the person who makes Vinted Pay's security posture match its growth. Vinted Pay is a rare security problem in the best sense: a fintech scaling across multiple European licences at marketplace speed, where security cannot be a compliance checklist or an isolated engineering task - it has to be built into the core financial architecture. Its attack surface spans multi-region AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines and payment pages, wallets holding members' money, the cardholder and personal data behind them, and a regulatory perimeter - PCI DSS, DORA, Bank of Lithuania and FCA rules - that rises every year.</p> <p>Working at staff / senior staff level as an individual contributor embedded in the Payments Engineering leadership team, you will own the security of that whole estate. Vinted Security runs a federated model: the central team sets thresholds and provides core services (pentesting, threat intelligence, SSDLC tooling, compliance), while each business unit owns local execution. Vinted Pay already owns part of its local execution; your job is to lead and scale it - this is not a policy or audit role, it is an engineering role with a mandate: translate regulatory requirements into technical guardrails and drive practical controls alongside Vinted Pay's platform and software engineers. You will work directly with Vinted Pay's Director of Engineering and functionally with the Vinted Security senior team and your security peers in Marketplace, Vinted Go, and Platform.</p> <p>This is a build role with room to grow: you start hands-on, closing the highest-impact gaps yourself and setting direction for the security work already under way, and as the function matures you will shape and functionally lead Vinted Pay's security engineering capability.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the Vinted Pay security roadmap end to end: assess the estate, prioritise by real attack paths, and drive risks to closure - a multi-quarter roadmap that shapes how Vinted Pay defends its infrastructure and payment assets, rather than reacting to the next audit.</li> <li>Turn regulation into engineering: map PCI DSS, DORA, and Bank of Lithuania and FCA requirements into practical, automated security controls and engineering guardrails - compliance as a by-product of how Vinted Pay builds, not a parallel workstream.</li> <li>Find and close the operational blind spots: run deep technical reviews of our AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines, SIEM and logging, and vulnerability management tooling (e.g. Wiz), and fix what you find - prioritised by exposure, not by finding count.</li> <li>Own PCI DSS and data protection architecture: payment page isolation, script monitoring, data encryption, and least-privilege access across multi-region environments - and turn those controls into evidence that stands up to assessors and regulators.</li> <li>Lead cross-functional security initiatives across Payments Platform, Payments Engineering, and Group Security, and drive them to delivery - whether execution sits with partner teams or you have to write the code yourself.</li> <li>Act as the technical arm of Vinted Pay's security accountable: maintain the risk register, prepare mitigation-or-acceptance decisions against centrally set thresholds, and represent Vinted Pay in the group's security governance.</li> <li>Embed secure development into Payments engineering so security lands at design time rather than after deployment, and raise the security fluency of Vinted Pay engineers so risk-based decisions happen well without you in the room - security as a delivery enabler, not a gate.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong hands-on security engineering experience on a real engineering foundation - you have built or run large production systems, and you can threat-model a payment flow, find the attack path yourself, and drive or build the fix.</li> <li>Experience in regulated payments or fintech - you have worked under PCI DSS and a financial regulator (FCA, Bank of Lithuania, CSSF, or equivalent) and know how their requirements become controls engineers actually run.</li> <li>A staff- or principal-level track record - you have defined, led, and delivered major, company-wide technical initiatives, and you set security direction through software design on high-scale, distributed systems rather than from the outside.</li> <li>The range to move across the <a href="https://staffeng.com/guides/staff-archetypes/">four archetypes</a> of staff engineering - tech lead, architect, solver, right hand - picking the one the domain needs together with the Director of Engineering, not the one you prefer.</li> <li>A way of working that engineers respect: evidence over assertions, attack paths over checklists, guardrails over gates.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and translate technical risk into business consequence for senior audiences, internal and external.</li> <li>Comfortable in our stack - Ruby on Rails, Go, MySQL, Temporal, AWS, SIEM and CSPM tooling - or eager to learn it, with a real interest in security and privacy as a field and the appetite to keep growing as an engineer and leader.</li> <li>Excellent written and spoken English.</li> <li>Advantage: experience building and running systems at massive scale (2+ million requests per minute), deep knowledge of observability tooling (Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus), and a passion for introducing new practices.</li> <li>Advantage: AWS security depth (IAM, KMS, multi-account and multi-region architecture), or hands-on CSPM (e.g. Wiz) and SIEM engineering.</li> <li>Advantage: privacy engineering experience, or offensive security background or certifications (e.g. OSCP).</li> </ul> <p>If this role excites you but you don't tick every box, we'd still like to hear from you.</p> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">25 working days of holiday</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Newest MacBook models</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Comprehensive Medical Insurance</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Group Life and Income Protection Insurance</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">A matched pension scheme up to a set limit</li> <li>Access to a discounted gym membership plan</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Frequent team-building events</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£97,800</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£169,100 GBP</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure and Efficiency
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>You will be a SME and technical leader in engineering Infrastructure, productivity and enterprise tooling, partnering with globally distributed Engineering, Product and Security teams and systems.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Be Doing</strong></h3> <p>Roku is seeking a world class engineer to be a true force multiplier by owning the strategy, architecture, and long-term execution of engineering infrastructure, enterprise tooling, and AI-assisted workflow automation. This architect/strategist role drives org-wide improvements in engineering productivity, delivery throughput, quality, security posture, and cost efficiency by building platforms, working practices and automation (including AI/LLM-enabled capabilities) that scale across geographies and time zones.</p> <p> </p> <p></p> <h3>How will I use AI at Roku?</h3> <p>At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. <br>We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <p></p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <p><strong>AI-First Automation & Intelligent Tooling </strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and lead an <strong>AI-first automation roadmap</strong> for Engineering Infrastructure and Enterprise Tooling (e.g., reducing waste, accelerating reviews, improving incident response, increasing release confidence).</li> <li>Architect and ship <strong>AI/LLM-enabled workflow automation</strong> across the SDLC (e.g. risk assessment, automated build, test and deployment, intelligent test selection, change-impact analysis, auto-triage of build/test failures).</li> <li>Establish policies and guardrails for AI usage in internal tools: <strong>data handling, prompt/response logging, model/provider selection, evaluation, fallback behaviors, and abuse prevention</strong>.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Dev Productivity & Enterprise Tooling (Global Scale)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set technical direction and standards for the globally used developer tools, including build systems. Source code management, branching/release strategy, and self-service support tools.</li> <li>Architect and evolve, CI/CD and build/test pipelines using <strong>Jenkins</strong>, <strong>Docker</strong>, and build systems (<strong>Bazel /BitBake/Yocto </strong> <strong>preferred</strong>) to support multi-site engineering environments.</li> <li>Own and scale test and quality workflows leveraging <strong>test management systems</strong> (e.g., <strong>TestRail</strong> or equivalent), enabling consistent traceability, reporting, and release sign-off across distributed teams.</li> <li>Drive <strong>Jira</strong> workflow design and automation (templates, guardrails, integrations) to provide consistent cross-org visibility and execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Workflow Automation (Cross-Functional, Cross-Geo)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and implement automation spanning <strong>Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Partners</strong> (e.g., launch readiness, certification/release checklists, partner onboarding, incident/change workflows).</li> <li>Replace manual coordination with durable automation and integrations that work reliably across regions/time zones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Security, Cost, Performance, and Reliability (Distributed Systems)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Embed <strong>secure-by-default</strong> controls into pipelines and tooling (access control, secrets handling, audit trails, policy enforcement), including for AI-enabled systems.</li> <li>Improve build/test performance and reliability (build times, test duration, flake reduction, pipeline stability) using measurable KPIs and operational rigor.</li> <li>Drive cost efficiencies across tooling/infrastructure (compute utilization, caching strategies, license rationalization including AI/runtime costs and ROI tracking.</li> <li>This is a highly visible role and you will report directly to a Vice President of Engineering. This requires a very strong technical leader with experience in the development of consumer electronics devices. The right person for this role will have ability to collaborate well with engineering and partner teams.</li> <li>Own cross-team architectures and standards; drive adoption through influence, clear technical judgment, and sustained multi-quarter execution.</li> <li>Lead design reviews, mentor senior engineers, and unblock the hardest technical problems across distributed teams and systems.</li> <li>Provide long-term stewardship via roadmaps, operational maturity (runbooks/SLOs), and incident/postmortem practices suitable for 24/7 global operations.</li> <li>Establish yourself as the person others bring their hardest problems to</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>We’re Excited If You Have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s in Computer Science or Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience</li> <li>Prior experience at Staff, Principal, or Architect level</li> <li>Ownership in platform/infrastructure, developer productivity, CI/CD, build systems, or workflow automation, including work spanning globally distributed teams and systems.</li> <li>Strong, hands-on knowledge of:</li> </ul> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Git (workflows, branching strategies, release management)</li> <li>Jenkins (CI/CD pipeline design, scaling, reliability)</li> <li>Docker containers (reproducible build/test execution)</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>Build systems ( itBake/Yocto preferred)</p> <ul> <ul> <li>Jira (workflow design/automation, cross-team visibility)</li> <li>Test management systems (e.g., TestRail or equivalent)</li> </ul> <li>Demonstrated experience delivering automation at scale, including building platforms/components used by multiple teams.</li> <li>Strong systems thinking across security, reliability, performance, and cost tradeoffs.</li> <li>Excellent written communication (architecture docs, decision records, operating procedures).</li> <li>Experience building AI-assisted developer tooling (e.g., CI insights, test intelligence, code review automation, release risk scoring, incident copilots).</li> <li>Experience implementing evaluation/monitoring for AI systems (quality metrics, drift, offline test sets, human feedback loops).</li> <li>Extensive experience with software development on embedded Linux,  multi-process architectures and IPC mechanisms</li> <li>Experience working in large cross functional teams and ability to influence teams that don't report to you</li> <li>Ability to see the big picture while focused on short-term objectives and deliverables</li> <li>Ability to multi-task and drive parallel projects and distributed teams with tight deadlines</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h6>#LI-NM1</h6><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. title: AI Research Engineer, Pre-Training
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an AI Research Engineer (<strong>Pre-training</strong>) to join the HAIL team. HAIL (HRT AI Labs) is the team at HRT responsible for developing and maintaining our most powerful models, which are used by our trading teams to drive a significant fraction of our trading. We are building and deploying "foundation models for markets", that ingest and train on vast amounts of market and “alternative” data (such as language) to make predictions about future market state.</p> <p>As a <strong>pre-training</strong> research engineer on HAIL, you will have a general mandate to improve all aspects of large-scale model training, including but not limited to kernel development, training data loading, parallelism, networking, and fault-tolerance. You will work closely with our researchers to co-design and improve our models, and shape the research agenda.</p> <p>We have multiple large, modern, and rapidly growing GPU clusters, and we maintain a very high GPU-to-researcher ratio. We are simultaneously pursuing multiple strategies and developing many model types with different purposes, and we are strongly incentivized to squeeze as much as we can out of our systems. Your work will be directly, clearly, and highly impactful on the business, and it will be challenging: this is a field with no easy or obvious solutions.</p> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong engineering skills, especially any of: CUDA/Triton/Pallas/CuTe DSL kernel development, lower-level PyTorch/JAX/XLA development, CUDA Graphs, FPGA/ASIC experience</li> <li>Must have two or more years work experience building deep learning systems, for any domain: robotics, biology, chemistry, physics, audio, video, recommendations, etc.</li> <li>Experience translating methods between areas of application is highly valued</li> <li>LLM experience is valuable, but not necessary</li> <li>Finance experience is not required</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 250,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). description: Note: Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market. Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API. Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify), with Blackbird Ventures, WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree and Ecliptic Venture Capital. Hear it from the team: Why Partly exists and AI at Partly . 🖍️ This role This is a product-builder role, not a ticket-taking one. You own a product surface end to end: you talk to the customer, form the idea, build it, ship it, measure it, and decide what happens next. The same person who understands the repairer writes the code. There is no handoff for product quality to leak through. You'll build at the center of a multi-trillion-dollar industry that still runs on phone calls, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge. Replacement parts is one of the largest physical markets on earth and one of the least digitised, and there is no established playbook to copy. Partly is creating the category. Our moat is Interpreter, a domain-specific AI model that understands parts, vehicles, and the messy real-world relationships between them in ways general-purpose models cannot. It is what lets software finally make sense of a physical, offline industry, and it is the engine underneath everything you build. And what you build is changing shape. We are not bolting AI onto old screens. We are creating genuinely new agentic experiences for a broad spectrum of users, from estimators and parts managers to accountants and suppliers, where people express intent and supervise outcomes while agents handle the mechanical work. Designing how that trust is earned, surface by surface, while each one still delivers value today, is the heart of the role. You'll work at an inflection point in how software itself gets built. AI-assisted development has collapsed the distance between an idea and a working version of it. The builders we want already work this way: they prototype in an afternoon, put it in front of real customers within days, and read the signal themselves. We want someone who works like that now, or is visibly building toward it. 💻 What will you do Build, not just specify. Genuine customer obsession: a real habit of spending time with users in their work context, with a track record of that depth driving what you build. Product taste and craft: the bar is experiences that feel effortless to time-pressured, non-technical users across fragmented, high-stakes workflows. Functional is not the finish line. A point of view on agentic product design: how an experience moves from manual operation to supervised delegation, and how automation earns user trust gradually rather than all at once. You build rapid prototypes yourself, with AI-assisted tools as a first instinct for testing an idea. Solid full-stack engineering with a frontend lean: production-quality code and sound fundamentals. Systems-specialist depth is not the point of the role. Trade-off fluency: you weigh product impact against engineering effort and often find a cheaper route to the same result. Strong analytical instinct: you define the metric, build the view, read it, and act, without waiting for a data team. The role in a sentence Be our first marketer and own the go-to-market: fill the sales calendar with CEOs, CFOs, COOs, CMOs and VPs of E-Commerce at mid-market omnichannel brands, and grow the brands that sign up on their own. The work Set the go-to-market plan: which buyers and markets we go after first, and through which channels. Run paid media yourself across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and anything else that works, alongside email, retargeting, campaigns aimed at named brands, events, and joint marketing with agencies, Shopify partners and systems integrators. Build and look after the route to a demo: landing pages, the booking flow, qualifying questions, quick follow-up and a clean handover to sales. Turn our case studies and the founders' experience into posts, pages and short videos. Use our own agents on your campaigns, starting with Ads-IQ on Google and Meta. title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Platform
description: Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing. Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products. We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing. Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn. The role Physical engineering is one of the hardest domains for AI. Designs have to meet standards, calculations must be deterministic and checkable, and a wrong number can end up in a power system or a data centre. CurieOS is built to let agents do real engineering work and to show exactly how every output was produced. The platform team builds the foundation that every workflow, agent and product on CurieOS depends on, and runs it in production for people who need to trust it. Your work sets the floor for how reliable our AI is, and the ceiling for what it can do. This is a small team, and you'll shape what we build as well as how. You'll see the results of those decisions in production within days. If you want a narrow, well-defined slice of a large system, this isn't the role. If you want to own a platform while it scales, it is. How we work We build with agents, not just for them. Everyone on the team works with the latest frontier models and coding agents every day, and token budgets won't hold you back. Part of what we build is CurieOS's ability to work on itself: triaging defects, proposing fixes and opening pull requests for engineers to review. So engineers here spend more of their time on design, review and judgement, and less on typing. If you already work this way, you'll feel at home. If you want to see how far it can go, this is the place to find out. You'll also work alongside our AI researchers, turning cutting-edge research and evals into things that run in the platform and in production. What you'll work on first In your first six months you'll work across the parts of CurieOS that customers have to be able to trust. Like everyone on the team you'll touch most of them, and go deepest where your interests take you: Tenancy, isolation and identity. How CurieOS keeps each customer separate, from shared multi-tenant accounts to dedicated single-tenant deployments. That covers data isolation, SSO and access control. You'll also be an engineering voice in customer security reviews. Release and production. How changes get to production safely: release gates, staged rollouts and rollback, automated smoke tests, on-call and incident response. We ship often, and you'll build what lets us keep doing that without breaking what customers rely on. Agent quality in production. Measuring how well agents perform on real customer workflows, working with our researchers to bring the latest evals into the platform, and using those measurements to decide what is good enough to release. A model or prompt change should have to pass the same gate as a code change. Observability and cost. Knowing the platform is healthy and what it costs. That means SLOs, tracing and alerting, plus cost telemetry and usage metering for every workflow and every customer, so we can see where model and compute spend goes and make deliberate choices about it. Infrastructure and deployment. One standard for how CurieOS is deployed, configured and upgraded in each environment, across our own cloud accounts, GPU capacity and customer-dedicated deployments. Where the platform is going Once those foundations are solid, there's a lot to shape next: Traceable results. Provenance for every number an agent produces: which inputs, tools, models and versions went into it, so our users can check it and sign it off. Agent runtime and context. How agents plan, call tools, manage context across long-running work and hand off to people at the right moment. Durable workflows. Orchestration that survives failures, retries and runs lasting hours, mixing agent steps with deterministic calculations. At Staff level, you'd set technical direction across these areas, not just within one. You'd own one of them end to end, run the design reviews that our research and forward deployed teams build on, make the architecture calls that are hard to reverse, and help shape how we hire and grow engineers. Our stack Python services on Kubernetes, running on AWS plus specialist GPU clouds for heavy compute. Strong engineers from Go, Kotlin, Java or a comparable stack will pick up the language quickly. What matters more is that you've run real systems in the cloud. You'll have most of these Designed and built backend services that other teams or customers relied on, and made the key decisions yourself. Owned a system in production after it shipped: the cloud infrastructure it ran on, on-call, incidents, how changes went out, and the monitoring that told you it was healthy. Built and run something where LLMs do real work for real users, and dealt with the cost, latency and quality trade-offs that come with it. Used coding agents heavily in your own work, with opinions on where they help and where they break. Led a project end to end, made trade-offs you can explain, and raised the bar for the engineers around you. Bonus points Shipped software to external enterprise customers: SSO, tenant isolation, per-customer deployments, security reviews. Run infrastructure as code at scale, or GPU workloads across more than one cloud provider. Helped a system or a company through a scaling phase, such as a platform going from internal use to many external customers. Worked closely with researchers, scientists, engineers or other domain experts and built what they actually needed. For Staff: a track record of setting technical direction beyond your own team, such as architecture other teams adopted, a migration you led across several teams, or engineers you've grown into senior roles. You don't need a background in materials, chemistry or engineering. You'll pick up the domain from the people who have it. Why Orbital Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company. We put frontier AI into the making of critical physical products, from advanced materials to data-centre engineering. Our research team works at the cutting edge, from universal interatomic potentials to GPU-native simulation, and we turn that research into tools engineers use every day. CurieOS is the platform that brings it together: the AI operating system the whole company runs on, which customers are starting to depend on for their own engineering work too. title: Account Executive
description: Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading. Take a proactive approach to pipeline building across online and offline channels. Collaborate Across Teams: Work cross-functionally with product, operations, and marketing to feed customer insights back into the business and improve the platform. Skilled in using LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS tools, and Google Suite to streamline the recruitment process for both active and passive candidates. Proficient in sourcing talent across a range of seniority levels, from entry-level graduates to senior professionals. Expertise in conducting behavioral and competency-based interviews with a strong ability to effectively evaluate candidates’ skills, cultural fit, and potential. Experience managing both high-volume hiring and specialized searches for niche roles. We offer a competitive salary for this role along with an equity component as part of the total compensation package. The final compensation, including salary and equity, will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and market conditions. Market-led and competitive benefits package including access to a self-development budget for conferences, books, or classes. Join us onsite in our inspiring office spaces in Berlin, NYC, or London. title: Regional Sales Director
description: Job Title: Regional Sales Director, Private Sector (Financial Services), NEMEA Location: London, United Kingdom The Chainalysis Private Sector team helps financial services organizations understand blockchain activity, manage financial crime risk, and adopt digital assets with confidence. Across NEMEA, we work with banks, fintechs, payments businesses, and digital asset companies to address compliance, fraud, and investigation needs. Our sales team partners with specialists across the business to connect customer priorities with the right blockchain intelligence solutions. As Regional Sales Director, you lead and develop the Private Sector Financial Services sales team across NEMEA from London. You own the regional sales strategy and revenue performance, combining disciplined execution with hands-on support for complex enterprise deals. You build senior customer relationships and help the team translate financial crime challenges and digital asset opportunities into clear business value. You create an accountable, collaborative environment where sales executives develop their skills and consistently deliver results. In this role, you'll: Lead, coach, and develop a team of sales executives to meet and exceed individual and regional revenue targets. Define and execute the NEMEA financial services sales strategy, prioritizing markets, customer segments, and accounts based on opportunity and customer needs. Own regional bookings and annual recurring revenue targets, balancing new customer acquisition with expansion across existing accounts. Build qualified pipeline through account planning, targeted prospecting, and coordinated engagement with Marketing, Sales Development, and partners. Guide complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery through negotiation and close, engaging compliance, fraud, risk, investigations, technology, procurement, and executive stakeholders. Build relationships with senior financial services decision-makers and help customers connect blockchain intelligence to their business objectives. Maintain accurate forecasts and Salesforce records, using pipeline reviews and sales activity data to identify risks and coach the team. Partner with Solutions Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and other specialists to develop customer solutions, support adoption, and identify expansion opportunities. Stay current on digital asset adoption, financial crime trends, and relevant UK and European regulatory developments to inform account strategies and customer conversations. Recruit and onboard sales executives, establish clear expectations, and build a collaborative team culture across the region. We're looking for candidates who have: 7+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS sales experience, including at least 3 years leading and developing quota-carrying sales teams. A record of meeting or exceeding multimillion annual recurring revenue targets in complex, consultative sales environments. Experience selling technology or data solutions to financial services organizations, including banks, fintechs, or payments businesses. Experience engaging compliance, financial crime, fraud, risk, or investigations teams and translating their needs into a business case. Experience leading sales across multiple markets, with an understanding of the UK and broader NEMEA financial services landscape. Demonstrated ability to coach sales executives, recruit talent, and manage performance against clear goals. Strong executive communication and negotiation skills, with experience managing complex procurement processes and multiple decision-makers. Proficiency in Salesforce and sales analytics, with a disciplined approach to pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning. Nice to have experience: Experience selling blockchain intelligence, financial crime analytics, fraud prevention, or RegTech solutions. Knowledge of digital assets, stablecoins, and blockchain use cases in banking and payments. Familiarity with UK digital asset regulation, EU MiCA requirements, AML/KYC obligations, and FATF guidance. An established network of financial services relationships across EMEA, additional regional language skills, or experience developing partner-led opportunities. About Chainalysis Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, and investigate criminal cases. As adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what’s happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence. You belong here. At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. Some of the ways we’re ensuring we keep learning are an internal Diversity Committee, Days of Reflection throughout the year including International Women’s Day, Harvey Milk Day, World Humanitarian Day, and UN International Migrants Day, and a commitment to continue revisiting and reevaluating our diversity culture. We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. Additionally, if you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here . We can’t wait to meet you. AI at Chainalysis AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it. AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before. About Chainalysis Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation. You belong here. At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture. title: AI Engineer
description: <h2>Opportunity</h2> <p>Brunswick is on an exciting journey to harness the power of artificial intelligence and data science to enhance the way we work and the advice we provide to clients. As we continue to expand our AI capabilities, we are looking for an AI Engineer to join our growing team.</p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining AI-powered applications that deliver real value across the business. Working closely with our existing AI team, you will help build innovative solutions using modern AI technologies, with a particular focus on large language models (LLMs).</p> <p>This is an excellent opportunity for someone with hands-on experience developing and deploying AI applications who enjoys solving complex problems, working with a high degree of autonomy, and turning emerging technologies into practical, high-quality products.</p> <p>You will thrive in this role if you are curious, creative, and passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges. You take pride in writing robust, maintainable code and enjoy collaborating with colleagues to continuously improve and expand our AI capabilities.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Your main responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li>Support, run, and iterate existing AI applications.</li> <li>Design, develop, deploy, and maintain new AI applications which can be scaled across multiple business use cases, driving operational and commercial outcomes.</li> <li>Trial and test solutions with end users to iterate and optimise them.</li> <li>Research and analyse data sets using a variety of statistical and machine learning techniques.</li> <li>Track and understand the evolving AI landscape.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <p>The successful candidate will be a highly professional, well-rounded individual with strong problem-solving skills, engineering expertise, strategic thinking, and excellent interpersonal skills. They will have a strong academic background complemented by an outstanding career to date. Standout candidates will demonstrate:</p> <ul> <li>Experience building solutions with large language models (LLMs) and a deep understanding of the broader generative AI landscape.</li> <li>Experience designing datasets, conducting model evaluations, and fine-tuning foundation models to improve task-specific performance.</li> <li>Strong Python development skills, including experience writing production-quality code.</li> <li>Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, HTML, and CSS.</li> <li>A solid understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.</li> <li>An undergraduate degree in a quantitative discipline, such as Mathematics or Computer Science, or equivalent relevant industry experience.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment with changing priorities and an iterative, user-focused approach to development.</li> <li>Curiosity, a strong sense of ownership, and the ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.</li> <li>Previous experience in professional services would be advantageous.</li> <li>Experience developing cloud applications on Microsoft Azure would be advantageous.</li> <li>Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g. CI/CD, Git) would be desirable.</li> <li>Knowledge of, or experience with, secure software development practices would be advantageous.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <p>Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1>About Brunswick</h1> <p>Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. </p> <p>Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.</p> <p>Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. </p> <p> </p> <p><em>Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our <a href="https://www.brunswickgroup.com/app/uploads/Group-Privacy-Notice-for-Employees_April-2026.pdf" target="_blank">Global Privacy Notice</a> to understand how your data is managed.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . ability to identify errors Exceptional ability to communicate and foster positive business relationships with both internal and external stakeholders Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines Fluent in English - both written and verbal Experience in data analysis and process automation using data visualization tools, SQL, Python, or similar is a plus It’s great if you are: Looking to progress your career and explore management How we Upvest in you: Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits. Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program. Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements. Inclusion : We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. title: AI Solutions Lead
description: Our Mission: Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement. Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . The Role AI is changing what it means to deploy enterprise software. Configuring a customer's procurement workflows used to mean weeks of manual setup, integration by integration, edge case by edge case. Increasingly, that first-draft build work can be directed rather than done by hand: AI agents can generate workflow configurations, draft integration mappings, and produce the initial pass on a customer's setup. The job shifts with it. Instead of building every workflow yourself, you specify exactly what needs to exist, direct AI to build it, and apply the judgment AI can't: is this the right configuration for this customer's approval policy, will Legal and Finance actually sign off on it, does it hold up once real spend starts flowing through it. In practice, that might mean catching that the approval chain AI just drafted works perfectly for HQ, but misses a regional delegation-of-authority rule that would fail an audit in the customer's APAC entity. As Omnea's AI Solutions Lead, you own deployment of the Omnea platform end to end - typically running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently - for some of Europe's most recognisable companies. You advise customers on the best-fit configuration, direct AI-assisted build work to get there fast, and validate every output against what the customer actually needs. You'll also deal with the politics that come with every enterprise rollout: the Legal team wanting one more sign-off, the Finance stakeholder who doesn't trust the new approval flow, the exec sponsor who's gone quiet. You become the internal voice of the customer, and you're judged on outcomes you can point to: time to launch, post-go-live CSAT, and whether that customer becomes a case study or reference. This is an early hire on Omnea's customer team, working directly with our sales, customer, product, and engineering leadership. The future shape of the role is yours to define! What You'll Do Discover and design Run discovery with customer stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, and IT, and translate their process into an Omnea configuration Design the target workflow: approval chains, routing logic, integrations, and the edge cases that make procurement hard On a deployment with a dozen-plus integrations, you own the sequencing - what has to land first, what blocks what - and the harder calls underneath it: which system is the source of truth for a given entity, and how records reconcile when two systems key that entity differently Define success criteria and a realistic path to go-live with the customer's project sponsor Build with AI, not instead of it You're not just directing AI to draft your own deliverables faster - you're configuring the specialized agents Omnea's customers rely on every day: an intake agent that knows how to ask a procurement analyst the right follow-up question, a risk agent that flags what actually matters to this customer's Legal team The real leverage comes from chaining agents together - an intake agent that hands clean, structured requests to a risk agent, which in turn routes into approvals with the right context already attached. You design how those agents work as a system, not just individually Writing a spec for one agent is a skill. Writing one that holds up across a chain of agents - where one agent's output becomes another's input - is the actual bar here Validate every AI-generated output against the customer's actual process, policy, and edge cases before anything ships Handle what AI can't: judgment calls on ambiguous requirements, custom logic, and anything that needs a human read on internal politics Deploy and prove value Present configured workflows to stakeholders, from procurement analysts to CFOs, working through the pushback and internal politics that come with any enterprise rollout, and win their buy-in Run multi-day onsite workshops with customers, coordinating dozens of stakeholders across multiple workstreams at once - a different muscle than a single stakeholder meeting Project-manage the deployment: timelines, blockers, stakeholder alignment, and a clear path to launch, acting as an extension of the customer's team Track adoption after go-live and keep the configuration working as the customer's process evolves Work with Product and Engineering during the design phase, not just after something breaks in the field - you're often the earliest signal on whether a new module will hold up for an enterprise customer, and that shapes what gets built next What's Different About This Role You'll spend more time specifying and validating than building from scratch. AI produces the first draft; you make sure it's right for this customer Writing instructions AI can act on precisely is a skill you'll build fast here. Vague requests produce vague configurations Judgment matters more, not less. AI speeds up the build, but you decide whether the output is right for this contract, this Board, this customer You'll keep experimenting as our AI tooling evolves, and share what works with the rest of the team About You We don't expect you to know how to do all of this on day one. TL;DR: you're ambitious and hard-working, as comfortable directing an AI agent through a tricky configuration as you are presenting a project plan to an exec. You make up for any gap in experience with hunger and a genuine growth mindset. You derive energy from building relationships, shipping projects, and making customers succeed. 4-8 years in a fast-paced, high-bar environment: a startup, scale-up, consulting, banking, or something you built yourself Less experience? Check out our Solutions Associate role Comfortable directing AI tools to produce first-draft work, and confident enough in your own judgment to catch what's wrong. Prior use of tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor is a strong plus. What matters most is your ability to write clear, specific instructions and evaluate what comes back Client-facing experience, or the natural gravitas to be excellent at it. We've signed up to the Future Founder Promise An excellent communicator: clear and concise, verbal and written, even when the subject is complicated Highly organised: comfortable running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently, each at a different stage, without dropping any of them At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! title: Principal Database Engineer
description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken’s Core Infrastructure Engineering team builds and operates the shared data systems behind critical production services. Our estate spans on-premises and cloud infrastructure, with MariaDB at its centre and Kafka, Redis and Elasticsearch across the wider platform. We’re hiring a Principal Database Engineer to bring long-term experience and technical judgment to this estate. You’ll assess it, set the goals and direction, and work hands-on with the team to deliver measurable improvements. This is an individual contributor role with influence across teams and several quarters of work. The opportunity Review the estate against business needs and production evidence. Judge reliability, scale, cost and operational complexity, identifying what should be preserved and where investment or simplification would make a difference. Define the target architecture and measurable goals. Agree a prioritised roadmap with engineering leads and dependent teams, explaining the trade-offs and sequencing work around delivery risks. Execute that roadmap with the team through design, implementation and adoption. Stay personally involved in difficult migrations and scaling decisions, with representative benchmarks, data-integrity checks and credible cutover and rollback plans. Adapt the plan as evidence changes and verify the results in production before calling the work complete. Investigate difficult MariaDB failures and performance limits through the engine, storage and application behaviour. Improve fleet reliability through useful observability, safer changes and tested backup, restore and disaster recovery procedures. Set recovery objectives with service owners and prove them through exercises. Build and maintain production software for database provisioning, upgrades and routine maintenance. Make self-service workflows safe and auditable, incorporating access controls and change evidence with Security and Compliance. Work with application teams on schemas, transaction boundaries, queries and data-store choices. Make the operational consequences clear and resolve dependencies that span teams. Mentor engineers across the team through design reviews, pairing and incident analysis. Help them deepen their database expertise and take ownership of technical decisions. Participate in on-call and incident response, leaving clear operational ownership and following through on lessons from production. What you bring 8+ years operating and evolving production database estates at scale. You have assessed inherited systems, set technical direction and delivered improvements with engineering teams, and can explain how those decisions held up over time. Strong understanding of high availability, replication and distributed database failure modes. You can explain consistency and availability trade-offs and reason about transaction boundaries and reliable event delivery, including transactional outbox patterns. Deep, recent hands-on MariaDB expertise, including InnoDB, MVCC and transaction isolation, locking, query optimisation, binary logs and MariaDB GTID replication. You can explain the mechanisms and diagnostic evidence behind your decisions. Personal ownership of MariaDB incident diagnosis, performance tuning and tested restore or point-in-time recovery. You can explain what you did, how you established data integrity and what remained uncertain. Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, Rust or a comparable language. You have personally built and maintained production software or automation for database workflows such as provisioning, failover, online schema changes and self-service operations, using version control, code review and delivery pipelines, with tested failure handling. Strong low-level Linux, Kernel, storage and networking fundamentals, with the ability to investigate problems beyond the database process. Clear written technical judgment and demonstrated delivery across teams without reporting-line authority. You help stakeholders make sound database design and lifecycle decisions, and develop experienced engineers through shared delivery. Nice to haves Experience operating databases in containerised, hybrid on-premises/cloud or multi-region environments. Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code or GitOps, including their operational trade-offs. Experience with database proxies or load-balancing layers (MaxScale, HAProxy, ProxySQL, or similar). Experience with PostgreSQL, Vitess, TiDB, ScyllaDB, ClickHouse or internal database platforms; operational knowledge of Kafka, Redis/Valkey or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. Experience in regulated environments or contributions to database engines, operators and other infrastructure software. description: FIX Onboarding & Client Services, EMEA Hybrid, London, UK (3+ days per week in-office) | Full-Time About Us Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year ( Risk.net ). Partner with account management, sales and product teams to ensure a positive client experience and successful delivery of platform enhancements. What We Need 2-5 years of experience in a client onboarding, integration, or technical support role within financial technology, trading, or brokerage. Good working knowledge of the FIX protocol — message structures, session management, and common trading workflows. Genuine comfort troubleshooting FIX connectivity, analysing logs, and resolving integration issues, with the judgement to know when to dig deeper. Familiarity with FX and Equities trading environments, order lifecycle management, and market data connectivity — genuine interest in working across multiple asset classes rather than staying within one. A genuinely proactive, tech-first mindset — someone who treats our AI and automation tooling as a way to go further and faster, not a replacement for good judgement, and who naturally looks for ways to improve a process rather than simply following it. Nice-to-have: Experience with OMS/EMS platforms, liquidity aggregators, or trading system integrations. Exposure to other API protocols and architectures (REST, WebSocket) — relevant given the depth of our own API. Scripting or automation experience (e.g. Python) and familiarity with monitoring tools (Splunk, Grafana, or similar). Understanding of financial market structure and post-trade workflows. What You Get A genuinely rich API to work with — not a thin FIX wrapper bolted onto a legacy system. You'll onboard clients onto an API with real depth across order routing, execution reporting, and market data — the kind of platform where understanding the protocol properly actually matters. Breadth across FX, Equities, and digital assets — most FIX/onboarding roles sit inside a single asset class. Here you'll build knowledge across all three, at a network connecting 40+ liquidity providers — exposure that compounds faster than a single-product environment. Real ownership of the tech-to-business bridge — you're not just configuring sessions, you're the person translating FIX/API detail into client outcomes clients actually care about. That combination — technical credibility plus commercial judgement, is the actual shape of this role. A genuinely tech-first operation — we've built dedicated AI tooling for this function specifically, so your ramp-up is faster and your day-to-day is spent on the client and integration problems that need real judgement, not repetitive configuration work. A small, senior team — you'll work directly alongside Client Services, TechOps, and engineering, with real visibility into how the platform works end to end, not a large layer of process between you and the people who built it. Growth across the business — the skills this role builds (protocol depth, client-facing technical credibility, cross-asset exposure) are the same ones that open doors internally. Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites Our Hiring Process We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. It brings together account-aligned technical teams and deep specialists to help customers design, validate, deploy, and scale production workloads on CoreWeave’s AI Cloud platform.</p> <p><strong>About the role: </strong>The Senior Director of Product & Engineering, EMEA reports to the VP and Managing Director of EMEA, with a matrix reporting line to the Global VP of Field Engineering and SVP of Product. As the senior field technology leader for the region, you will lead all EMEA field technical functions, with direct management accountability for account-aligned technical teams and matrix leadership of specialist teams. You will set the regional technical strategy, build a consistently high level of mastery across the specialisms required to serve AI infrastructure customers, and ensure teams are motivated, appropriately deployed, and equipped to succeed. Working across EMEA and global leadership, you will turn customer and business priorities into a disciplined technical operating model that accelerates adoption, expansion, and measurable value from CoreWeave’s AI Cloud platform. You will be responsible for ensuring the product strategy of CoreWeave is assimilated across field teams in EMEA and - working with field enablement - ensuring that all teams maintain a high level of product competency. </p> <ul> <li>Set and execute the EMEA Field Product & Engineering strategy, operating model, and priorities in partnership with the VP and Managing Director of EMEA, Global VP of Field Engineering and SVP of Product.</li> <li>Act as the senior field technology voice for EMEA, shaping go-to-market priorities, customer engagement models, technical positioning, and regional investment decisions.</li> <li>Lead the account-aligned technical organization with direct accountability for organization design, performance, coaching, succession, hiring, retention, and leadership development across EMEA.</li> <li>Provide matrix leadership to specialist technical teams, aligning priorities, coverage, engagement standards, and accountability while partnering effectively with their global functional leaders.</li> <li>Build a measurable technical mastery system—including skills assessments, learning plans, communities of practice, playbooks, reference architectures, and proof frameworks—that keeps teams current across AI infrastructure, compute, Kubernetes, networking, storage, security, observability, and AI/ML workloads.</li> <li>Create repeatable engagement mechanisms that move customers from discovery and architecture through validation, onboarding, production readiness, adoption, optimization, and expansion on CoreWeave’s AI Cloud platform.</li> Support, and Operations resources around successful outcomes.</li> <li>Partner with EMEA sales leadership on account strategy, technical qualification, executive alignment, and resource allocation, sharing accountability for technical win rate, qualified pipeline, deal velocity, time to production, workload adoption, and expansion.</li> <li>Establish a rigorous regional operating cadence covering goals, metrics, forecasting, capacity and coverage planning, business reviews, and annual planning so performance and investment choices are visible and evidence based.</li> <li>Create a structured feedback loop from EMEA customers and field teams into Product and Engineering, translating recurring requirements, adoption blockers, competitive signals, and market dynamics into clear roadmap input.</li> <li>Represent CoreWeave’s technology vision through executive briefings, customer forums, conferences, and thought leadership, while bringing relevant market insight back into the business.</li> <li>Represent EMEA in global Field Engineering leadership, scale regional best practices across the company, and create an inclusive, high-performance environment in which teams are motivated and enabled to help customers adopt CoreWeave.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in technical design, implementation, consulting, pre-sales, solutions architecture, or another customer-facing technical discipline within cloud infrastructure, AI/ML platforms, enterprise software, or adjacent markets.</li> <li>10+ years of technical leadership experience, including 7+ years leading managers, senior individual contributors, or multi-country Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, or comparable customer-facing technical organizations.</li> <li>A record of leading distributed technical organizations through rapid growth, transformation, changing market conditions, and complex organizational dependencies.</li> <li>Strong technical credibility in cloud-native and distributed-systems architecture, with depth across several of the following domains: accelerated compute, Kubernetes, networking, storage, security, observability, data platforms, or AI/ML workload architecture.</li> <li>Demonstrated success guiding complex enterprise customers from strategy and solution design through validation, production deployment, operationalization, measurable adoption, and expansion.</li> <li>Experience advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders and translating complex architecture into business value, investment choices, delivery risk, and operating decisions.</li> <li>Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles and connecting technical strategy to qualified pipeline, technical wins, deal progression, customer adoption, and expansion.</li> <li>A record of hiring, developing, and retaining technical leaders, together with building measurable enablement, accreditation, or continuous-learning programs that close capability gaps.</li> <li>Experience operating a metrics-based field organization, including goals, forecasting, capacity and coverage planning, resource prioritization, business reviews, and performance inspection.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to align Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, partners, specialist teams, and global leaders without relying solely on positional authority.</li> <li>Experience operating across EMEA markets, with the ability to travel regionally and internationally as required to support customers, teams, and company priorities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leadership experience in a high-growth AI cloud, hyperscale cloud, data-center infrastructure, enterprise platform, or developer-platform business.</li> <li>Deep familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing, large-scale AI training or inference, high-performance computing, and the operational requirements of distributed AI workloads.</li> <li>Experience navigating EMEA-specific customer requirements, including data sovereignty, security, regulation, procurement, and cross-border operating considerations.</li> <li>Experience establishing specialist communities of practice or centers of excellence, influencing product roadmaps, and representing a company through external technical thought leadership.</li> <li>A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience; postgraduate description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™.
